story.title: Apostles Stachys, Apelles and Companions
story.subtitle: Six of the Seventy, named by St Paul in Romans 16
story.week_line: Saturday of the 22nd week after Pentecost
story.commemorating: Hieromartyr John Kochurov · New Martyr Nicholas of Chios

end.quote: My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.

reel.caption:
The Gospel for Saturday, October 31 (New Calendar): Luke 8:16–21, read aloud.

“No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.”

“Be careful therefore how you hear.” When He is told that His mother and brothers are standing outside, the Lord answers: “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

Today we also remember the holy Apostles Stachys, Apelles, Amplias, Urban, Narcissus and Aristobulus, Hieromartyr John Kochurov and New Martyr Nicholas of Chios.
